adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces `refreshOAuthTokens` as the centralized gate for credential-sync behavior (it checks `APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` and `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT` and, when enabled, calls the external sync endpoint instead of the provider refresh). Multiple integrations were updated to route refreshes through it (e.g., Google, Hubspot, Lark, Office365, Webex, Zoom). However, `packages/app-store/salesforce/lib/CalendarService.ts` adds an inline refresh `fetch("https://login.salesforce.com/services/oauth2/token", ...)` and does not call `refreshOAuthTokens` anywhere, so when credential sharing/sync is enabled Salesforce will continue refreshing directly and never hit the external sync endpoint path. This is a concrete inconsistency within the set of modified integrations and means the new sync feature will not apply to Salesforce.
